author: Quinn's Ideas
description:
In Arthur C. Clarke’s “The Sentinel,” a lunar expedition finds a machine older than humanity. What was it waiting for—and what happens when its signal stops?

I look at Wilson’s explanation, the unease behind Clarke’s scientific optimism, and how this short story helped inspire 2001: A Space Odyssey.

This video discusses the full story, including its ending.
